title: AI Collage Art Generator
summary: Make collage art with AI: torn paper, cut-out photos, vintage engravings and mixed media layers. Describe it, pick a collage style, and Flick makes it.
body_markdown:
### How do I make collage art with AI?


Describe each element and the material it is cut or torn from, such as a whale cut from an old map over rooftops torn from magazine photos, add visible edges and shadows, then pick a collage style and generate. In Flick you can then animate the collage into a clip.


### Can AI make a photo collage from my own pictures?


Yes. Add your photos as reference images and ask for a paper collage that cuts and layers them with torn edges, tape and shadows; name which photo goes where so the layout stays clear.


### How do I make a vintage collage aesthetic?


Ask for aged sepia photographs, Victorian engravings, foxed cream paper and hand-coloured cut-outs in muted reds and ochres, with clean scissor edges and small shadows between layers.


### Can I make a collage animation?


Yes. Generate the collage first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one gentle movement, such as a paper boat bobbing on the lake, while asking to keep the paper texture.


### Is the collage art generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
